messages:
nina: Quick postmortem follow-up: recurring cache-eviction incidents. We need a compact runbook update: 1) a 5-step quick triage, 2) exact ops commands to paste, 3) clear escalation path w/ timeboxes + owners. Volunteers?

sam: I can draft the 5-step triage. Lean, copy-pasteable: 1) confirm scope (single model vs cluster), 2) check kvcache hit-rate delta, 3) inspect eviction events, 4) apply short mitigation, 5) open incident tag + notify.

trent: I'll add command snippets. Proposed additions (put verbatim in runbook):
```bash
# list eviction events (last 30m)
redwoodctl telemetry events list --filter type=eviction --since 30m

# quick kv stats
redwoodctl metrics query "sum(rate(kvcache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kvcache_requests_total[5m]))"

# tail runtime errors
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=runtime -c runtime --since=15m | tail -n 250

# fallback route to smaller model
redwoodctl route set --model model-small --traffic 100% --reason "eviction-fallback"
```

hema: Escalation path suggestion: oncall ack < 10m, eng-sre engaged < 20m if not mitigated, eng-runtime notified < 45m, leads + customer-sre at 90m. I'll own the escalation contact table and primary/secondary list.

ops-bot: Incident linked: INC-2026-1502. Reminder: runbook edits due in 6 days.

sam: Mitigation snippets I'll add: if hit-rate drops >25% -> increase shard_limit by 15% and restart cache pods one-by-one. If eviction reason == "oom" -> reduce batch_size or switch traffic to model-small. Example command: `redwoodctl config patch kvcache --shard-limit +15%`

trent: For telemetry examples I'll include grafana expressions: hit-rate: `increase(kvcache_hits_total[5m]) / increase(kvcache_requests_total[5m])`; 95th token latency: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))`.

carlos: Assigning owners & deadlines: sam -> triage doc + mitigation snippets (due: 2bd), trent -> ops commands + telemetry queries + sample outputs (due: 3bd), hema -> escalation table + rotation check (due: 4bd). I'll schedule a 20m sync in 48 hours to review.

nina: One tiny playbook rule to include: when unsure, reduce traffic to suspect model before mass restarts. Also tag any repeaters for deep analysis.

sam: ACK. Starting PR now and will tag @trent for command verification.

trent: ACK. I'll include sample log-match lines and a short troubleshooting table (eviction_reason -> next steps).

ops-bot: Reminder set: PRs due in 5 days.

carlos: Summary (copyable):
- sam: 5-step triage + mitigations (due in 2bd)
- trent: ops commands + telemetry + samples (due in 3bd)
- hema: escalation matrix + contacts + SLA timeboxes (due in 4bd)
Please reply to confirm ownership. :white_check_mark:
